default_font_dirs.description: Standard system directories where fonts are installed and scanned by default.

font_dirs.description: Additional user-specified font directories to include in the font search path.

family.description: Generic font family name to alias (e.g., 'serif', 'sans-serif', 'monospace').

fallback.description: Ordered list of specific font families to use as fallbacks when the generic family is requested.

alias_font_names.description: Define mappings from generic font families to concrete font families for compatibility with applications expecting common names.

enable_hinting.description: Enable font hinting to improve legibility on low-resolution screens.

enable_antialiasing.description: Enable font antialiasing for smoother text rendering.

subpixel_rendering.description: Subpixel layout for LCD screens: 'rgb', 'bgr', 'vrgb', 'vbgr', or empty string to disable (use 'none' in values if not desired).

prefer_embedded_bitmaps.description: Whether to prefer embedded bitmap strikes in fonts (e.g., for small sizes) over outline rendering.
